messages.content:
# Orbital Salvage

A 3D space-navigation game built with **Three.js** and **Vite**. Pilot a compact
salvage ship through a miniature solar system: beam up drifting cargo with your
tractor beam, dodge asteroid fields and proximity mines, manage fuel and hull
integrity, and dock at the orbital station to sell your haul before the mission
clock runs out.

All visuals and audio are procedural — no external models, textures, images, or
sound files.

## Commands

```bash
npm install        # install dependencies
npm run dev        # start the dev server (Vite)
npm run test       # run unit tests (Vitest)
npm run build      # production build
npm run validate   # production build + all tests
```

## Controls

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `W` / `S` (or `↑` / `↓`) | Forward / reverse thrust |
| `A` / `D` (or `←` / `→`) | Turn (yaw) |
| `Q` / `E` | Roll |
| `Shift` | Boost (burns fuel faster, higher top speed) |
| `Space` | Tractor beam (pulls nearby salvage) |
| `P` | Pause / resume (overlay with controls) |
| `M` | Mute / unmute procedural audio |
| `R` | Restart mission (from pause or the results screen) |
| `Esc` | Quit to the main menu (from pause, mid-mission, or the results screen) |

## Gameplay

- Collect drifting salvage pods — beam them up or fly into them. Pods come in
  three **cargo tiers**:
  - **Standard** (green core): common, base value.
  - **Rare** (gold core): small and fast-drifting, +150 credits.
  - **Heavy** (orange core): big and slow, +80 credits but burns extra fuel
    while carried.
- **Proximity mines** (spiky, red core, faint red shell) drift through the
  field. Enter their trigger radius and they detonate: hull damage plus a
  knockback impulse.
- Dock at the station's glowing ring (slow down inside the zone) to sell cargo.
  The ring turns **red** if you're moving too fast to dock safely.
- **Delivery combo**: consecutive deliveries without taking damage build a
  payout multiplier (×1.25 → ×1.5 → ×2). Any hit resets it.
- **Market surge**: in the final 60 seconds, salvage pays +25% and a few extra
  hazards spawn — a last push is worth it.
- Green canisters restore fuel. Asteroids and planets damage your hull.
- Win by reaching the credit target before time expires.

## Difficulty

Three presets (chosen on the start screen) are merged onto the base config by
`applyDifficulty()` — the base `CONFIG` is never mutated:

| Preset | Duration | Target | Fuel burn | Hazard damage | Hazards | Mines | Salvage value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Easy | 7:00 | 350 | ×0.8 | ×0.6 | 8 | 4 | ×1.25 |
| Normal | 5:00 | 500 | ×1 | ×1 | 12 | 6 | ×1 |
| Hard | 4:00 | 700 | ×1.3 | ×1.5 | 16 | 8 | ×1 |

Best credits and fastest win per difficulty are saved in `localStorage` and
shown on the results screen.

## Configuration

Every gameplay constant lives in [`src/config.js`](src/config.js)
(`CONFIG`). The main blocks:

| Block | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `mission` | duration (s), credit target |
| `difficulty.presets` | per-preset overrides merged by `applyDifficulty()` |
| `ship` | thrust, boost, drag, speed caps, fuel/hull, burn rates, invulnerability, impact damage |
| `gravity` | distance floor + force cap for the inverse-square pull |
| `salvage` | count, base value, drift, respawn, tractor range/pull, cargo capacity, `tiers` (value/weight/radius/drift/burnPenalty) |
| `mine` | count, drift, trigger radius, damage, knockback, respawn |
| `fuelCanister` | count, radius, fuel restored, respawn |
| `hazard` | count, radius, damage, orbit speed/radius, keep-out distances |
| `combo` | step table: consecutive deliveries → payout multiplier |
| `surge` | window (final seconds), salvage value bonus, extra hazards |
| `station` | position, dock radius, hub radius, dock speed limit, fast-dock damage, dock cooldown |
| `planets` | position, radius, gravity, color, ring/atmosphere per planet |
| `world` | soft boundary radius, salvage spawn shell (min/max radius) |
| `camera` | follow distance/height, lerp speed, shake decay |
| `effects` | particle pool size, particle lifetime |
| `loop` | `maxDelta` — the dt clamp so a background tab can't tunnel the physics |
| `limits` | `fuelWarnRatio` / `hullWarnRatio` — low-resource warning thresholds |
| `spawn` | `playerClearance` / `stationClearance` / `planetClearance` — spawn keep-out radii |

Tuning tip: change `CONFIG.mission.duration` to adjust the timer, the
`difficulty.presets` table to rebalance the presets, or `combo.steps` to make
the delivery chain steeper or flatter.

## Architecture

```
src/
  main.js                  entry point, boots the game
  config.js                all gameplay constants in one place
  game/
    Game.js                scene graph, game loop, pause, wiring
    GameState.js           mission state, fuel/hull, docking, combo, surge (pure)
    Difficulty.js          pure preset merge onto the base config
    Cargo.js               tier roll + hold value/burn (pure)
    Mines.js               proximity trigger query (pure)
    Stats.js               results-screen summary (pure)
  input/
    InputManager.js        keyboard state + intent sampling
  entities/
    PlayerShip.js          ship model, flight model, engine glow, tractor beam
    Planet.js              procedural planets with rings + atmosphere
    Station.js             orbital station with docking-zone visuals
    Salvage.js             salvage pods (3 tiers) + fuel canisters
    Hazard.js              orbiting asteroids
    Mine.js                drifting proximity mines
  systems/
    GravitySystem.js       inverse-square gravity with caps (pure)
    CollisionSystem.js     sphere collision + drift helpers (pure)
    SpawnSystem.js         spawn/recycle field entities
    EffectsSystem.js       pooled particles + procedural starfield
    AudioSystem.js         procedural WebAudio: engine hum, pickups, warnings
  ui/
    HUD.js                 DOM HUD, radar, overlays (start/pause/end)
  utils/
    math.js                pure vector math
    radar.js               radar projection + off-screen direction (pure)
    storage.js             per-difficulty records in localStorage
tests/
  math.test.js             vector math unit tests
  gravity.test.js          gravity falloff + cap tests
  collision.test.js        collision helper tests
  gamestate.test.js        fuel, damage, docking, win-condition tests
  cargo.test.js            tier roll + hold value/burn
  mines.test.js            proximity trigger query
  combo.test.js            delivery combo chain + reset
  difficulty.test.js       preset merge + clamping
  stats.test.js            results summary
  storage.test.js          records persistence
  audio.test.js            audio scheduling
  radar.test.js            radar projection
  config.test.js           config audit (new blocks, preset preservation)
```

Rendering (Three.js) is fully separated from deterministic game logic, which
lives in pure functions and is covered by Vitest.
